description: Straight-up, against-the-spread and over/under records since 1999 for prime-time and weather spots: Thursday, Sunday and Monday night, any prime-time kickoff, outdoor games at 40°F or colder, 32°F or colder (snow isn't recorded; this stands in for it), 15+ mph wind, 85°F+ heat, dome teams on the road outdoors or in the cold, and warm-weather teams in the cold. Narrow by team, opponent, home or road, favourite or dog, division, seasons. Raw record first with n and a 95% interval, then the holds_up test (held-out seasons, false-discovery correction, shrunk estimate), and the last ten games. For 'TNF unders', 'SNF favourites', 'MNF home dogs', 'Dolphins under 40 degrees', 'dome teams in the cold', 'wind over 15 unders', 'do unders hit in wind', 'snow games', 'warm-weather teams in December cold'.
